methodology: Pre-registered real-repo benchmark. Scenarios are committed BEFORE any measurement (anti cherry-picking; v1/v2 rows stay frozen). All token counts are measured with the calibrated BPE tokenizer on real repository bytes. Every scenario carries deterministic zero-loss gates; a gate failure disqualifies the scenario from the savings table. v3 adds: API surface map, KV-cache prefix locking replay, secret-guard interception, junk-read guard, prompt compaction (TOCP).
